---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Downivo / UniversalDownloader
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: []
---

**Warning:** Do not include passwords, API keys, tokens, personal information, or other secrets.

Describe the **problem** you want solved. A specific implementation is optional.

## Problem

What is difficult or missing today?

## Proposed solution

How you would like it to work, if you have an idea.

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered.

## Use case

Who benefits, and in what situation?

## Expected benefit

What becomes faster, clearer, or more reliable?

## Additional context

Links to related issues, screenshots, or similar apps (no private URLs).

Please check [docs/ROADMAP.md](../../docs/ROADMAP.md) and [docs/CONTRIBUTION_AREAS.md](../../docs/CONTRIBUTION_AREAS.md) before requesting large features. Collections, Activity Center, cloud sync, AI, and a sixth tab are out of scope unless maintainers agree.
